infy_q3_fy25_sanitized.xml.sanitization_statement: Sanitized subset of actual official XBRL containing core income line items, equity capital, quarter (OneD) vs 9M YTD (FourD) duration contexts, and segment dimension (OneReportableSegmentRevenue01D).

paytm_q3_fy25_loss_sanitized.xml.sanitization_statement: Sanitized subset of actual official XBRL demonstrating negative PAT (-₹208.5 Cr) and negative diluted EPS (-₹3.27).

hdfcbank_q3_fy25_banking_sanitized.xml.sanitization_statement: Sanitized subset of actual official banking XBRL demonstrating presence of InterestEarned / InterestExpended and total absence of RevenueFromOperations.

duplicate_and_nil_cases_sanitized.xml.purpose: Purpose-built synthetic XML fixture constructed to validate parser and methodological behavior on exact duplicates, compatible duplicates, conflicting duplicates, and reported nil (xsi:nil=true).
duplicate_and_nil_cases_sanitized.xml.sanitization_statement: Constructed fixture. Does NOT claim these specific numbers occurred in a single official filing; validates parser handling rules.

INFY_QUARTER_VS_YTD.conclusion: Quarterly and cumulative YTD facts share concept QName and period_end, but are strictly distinguished by context period_start and duration_days. Contexts with explicitMember dimensions represent segment breakdowns.

PAYTM_LOSS_FACTS.conclusion: Negative PAT and EPS are reported with leading minus signs and parsed into signed Decimals.

HDFCBANK_BANKING_NEGATIVE_CONTROL.conclusion: Banking taxonomy lacks standard corporate revenue line items. Confirms banking exclusion from non-financial normalization.

duplicate_policy_rules.RAW_OCCURRENCE_PRESERVATION: Physically distinct XML occurrences in the source document are preserved at the raw layer (document_id, source_occurrence_ordinal); never erased.
duplicate_policy_rules.EXACT_DUPLICATE: Identical economic coordinates and value; deduplicated at canonical promotion.
duplicate_policy_rules.COMPATIBLE_VALUE_DUPLICATE: Same economic coordinates, compatible values; preserve observations without picking highest precision as canonical truth.
duplicate_policy_rules.CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE: Same economic coordinates, incompatible values; preserve all, mark CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED.
duplicate_policy_rules.REPORTED_NIL: xsi:nil='true' preserved as is_nil=True, distinct from numeric 0.00.

proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D1: APPROVE two-layer architecture: Raw Source Fact Observation + Canonical Mapping.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D2: APPROVE source occurrence identity as separate from canonical economic identity and payload.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D3: APPROVE reported-facts-only normalization. No synthetic quarter subtraction.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D4: APPROVE period-safe canonical duration identity: period_start + period_end required.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D5: APPROVE raw dimensioned fact preservation; unsupported material dimensions excluded from initial enterprise promotion.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D6: APPROVE duplicate policy: preserve raw occurrences; no highest-precision winner; conflicting duplicates unresolved.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D7: APPROVE cross-exchange source observations remain independent in F2B; reconciliation deferred.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D8: APPROVE versioned canonical mappings and local reprocessing from immutable source documents/raw observations.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D9: APPROVE exact PIT inheritance from SI-F1; DATE_ONLY/UNKNOWN remain excluded from exact timestamp replay.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D10: APPROVE initial non-financial-only boundary: banks excluded empirically; NBFC/insurance conservatively excluded pending evidence; unknown issuer classification => not canonically normalized.
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D11: APPROVE secure XML parser requirement (exact dependency added only during reviewed F2B implementation).
proposed_owner_decisions_d1_to_d12.D12: APPROVE initial concept scope: 5 High-Confidence Canonical Promotion concepts + 2 Raw Mapping Proven but Canonical Context Rule Required concepts.
